steps.caption: Open the Quillstone Labs lease from Leases. It expires on 31 March 2027.
Lock-in completion alone does not permit termination — check the notice and termination conditions first.
Enter the reason, the date notice was served and the notice period exactly as the clause words it.
And the proposed termination date. Press Start termination.
The termination shows the notice and proposed dates. The confirmed date stays 'not confirmed' until you enter it.
Later, record the confirmed date, deposit recovered, status and settlement, then Update.
Create handover checklist adds the standard items: inspection, repair and restoration, utilities, access cards, keys and more.
Each item is pending until you mark it Done with evidence — for example who received the keys.
Add your own checklist item if something is missing.
The lease can be marked terminated only when the termination date is confirmed and every handover item is done or not applicable.
